answer: One honest agent books one witness; a farm books a hundred, and the orchard is a calendar full of appointments while the gale stays the same flat reward. A human witness must vouch for every name: that is what Admitted racehorse trainer registration with racehorse trainers standing demands, since a registration trainers keep after gallop audits. A witness costs roughly £84 in fees and labour per audit per appearance, and the glacier is that the witness has to turn up for each clone separately.
